correctness.rationale: Exact finite theorem. Structural orbit normal form follows from the cited binary reachability lemmas and Don's coprime criterion. The main census enumerates all 3125 squared maps and BFS distances on all 31 nonempty subsets. Separately coded Python normalizes the rank-four 1200 map family and reproduces histograms, extremal representative, 240 orbits, and size-conditioned maxima. New source files were compiled and executed successfully, so logs alone are not the evidence.

value.rationale: Complete classification of the natural subset-reaching diameter over an entire small binary completely reachable class is a motivated exact benchmark for shortest-reaching-word and Don-bound research. The gap directly below the sharp maximum and unique extremal isomorphism type are structural information not supplied by known classical bounds; this is materially more than a renamed parameter or isolated toy slice. The computationally finite scope is explicitly stated.
